name: Hoka no Otoko no Seieki de Harande mo Ii Desu ka ~Joshikousei Netorare Jijou~
original_name: 他の男の精液で孕んでもいいですか～女子校生寝取られ事情～
source:
Takashi and Youko are in love with each other. But one day, Youko moves to another town, which begins a long distance relationship. Several days later, Youko meets a man she used to play with when she was a kid. They gradually gets closer and finally sleep together...

[From ErogeShop]
